> **Capability note.** Guard PREVIEWS (the PreToolUse channel) are
> Claude-Code-only; under Codex the same guards still govern via the
> obligations/pack_context MCP tools and the compiled layer. Everything
> else here is harness-agnostic.

Author guards from incidents (3–7, each citing its decision; `guards: []`
is the valid inert form); install kit-shipped packs (`fathom layers
install <kit>/fathom-pack/layers/<pack>`, copy the consumer guard group
with provenance markers, narrow the globs); bind mounted modules or write
the explicit `bindings: []`; wire the pre-push verify gate loud on a
missing binary; then prove each activation by demonstration and `fathom
observe` any friction.
